title: Audit chain anchor (rizzstack.audit-anchor/1)
description: A checkpoint of the uirizz action audit chain, written by a collector outside uirizz (contrib/rizzstack-observability/audit_anchor.py) to its own append-only file. One anchor per 100 entries of a log segment (reason interval) and one for the last entry of a segment when the log rotates (reason rotation). A verifier recomputes the chain and fails on any anchor that does not match. It raises the bar against silent edits; it is not a signed or public transparency log.

log_id.description: Identifies one log segment: the hash of the segment's first entry (seq 1). A rotation starts a new segment.

seq.description: The anchored entry's seq within its segment.

ts.description: When the collector wrote the anchor.
